templates.title: Contrack
templates.name: contrack
templates.description: Self-hosted personal CRM with contacts, notes, reminders, interaction history, and local semantic search in one SQLite file. Optional AI providers and calendar, IMAP, and CardDAV connectors. Source: https://github.com/arvarik/contrack

env.name: AUTH_REQUIRED
env.label: Require sign-in
env.description: Keep enabled when reachable beyond localhost. On first visit, Contrack opens a setup screen to create the admin account.

env.name: PUBLIC_URL
env.label: Public URL (optional)
env.description: Root origin people open (e.g. https://crm.example.com, with no path) when behind a reverse proxy. Needed for passkeys, emailed links, and OAuth.

env.name: TRUST_PROXY_HOPS
env.label: Reverse proxy hops
env.description: 0 for direct access, or 1 behind one reverse proxy so rate limits, secure cookies, and audit logs use forwarded headers.

env.name: ALLOWED_HOSTS
env.label: Allowed hosts (optional)
env.description: Comma-separated extra hostnames (such as a Tailscale .ts.net name) allowed before the first account is created or while sign-in is off.

templates.note:
Open http://<your-host>:3210 right after deploying: the first visitor to open port 3210 creates the admin account, so complete setup before exposing the port publicly.

All persistent data (SQLite database, uploads, snapshots, and generated secret.key) is stored in /app/data, and local search models are bundled in the image. AI keys, OpenID Connect, outgoing mail, and connectors can be configured in Settings inside the app. Behind an HTTPS reverse proxy, set PUBLIC_URL and TRUST_PROXY_HOPS=1. See the self-hosting docs.
